# LiveWave

> Full-stack uptime monitoring platform for servers, APIs and websites.
> Real-time checks, Telegram alerts and rich dashboards. Built with
> NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL and Redis.

## Features

- Multi-protocol checks: HTTP, TCP, ICMP, DNS (5-60 min intervals)
- Telegram integration: OAuth login, alerts on status changes
- Secure auth: JWT access/refresh in httpOnly cookies + Redis
- Optimistic UI for instant feedback
- Observability: Prometheus metrics, Loki logs, Grafana dashboards

## Stack

- Backend: NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cron, JWT, Swagger
- Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, TanStack Query, Zustand, Recharts
- Infra: Docker Compose, pnpm workspaces
